name: Amanda Anisimova
hometown: Freehold Township, New Jersey, United States
intro: Amanda Anisimova is an American star from New Jersey. She hits one of the hardest backhands in tennis. Last year she reached the US Open final, right here!
story: Amanda started tennis at age five. She copied her big sister Maria. At 17 she made the semifinals of the French Open. Then she took a break from tennis to rest. She came back stronger and climbed to number 3 in the world.

funFacts.text: She won the US Open junior title in 2017. She beat Coco Gauff in the final!
She loves to paint. She showed her paintings at a gallery in New York.
Her favorite artist is Vincent van Gogh.
During her break, she helped at a dog shelter and took trips with friends.
She traded screen time for books. Now she reads instead of scrolling!
Her parents moved from Russia to America before she was born.
She won two big titles in 2025, in Qatar and Beijing.

watchFor: Watch her two-handed backhand, hit flat, hard, and right on the line.
